# Public-Fact Higher-Order Composition Fixture

This fixture represents five sourced stages of Apollo 11 as separate candidate
EventFrames. The facts are grounded in NASA's Apollo 11 mission overview. The
dataset-local `stage` and `group` labels are deterministic test keys; they do not
map to a person, account, host, or private session.

The fixture tests one bounded claim: compatible constituent frames can be
materialized as a reversible higher-order mission frame while preserving the
shared crew/objective invariants, the complete time envelope, every constituent,
and one directly retrievable representative. It does not validate autonomous
join discovery or claim that exact-field equality is a general invariant seeker.

Source: https://www.nasa.gov/missions/apollo/apollo-11/apollo-11-mission-overview/
